title: Finding a Podcast for the Commute
context: Maya 和 Noah 想找一档适合坐公交时听的播客，比较时长、话题和语速。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目是原创口语练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: My bus ride feels long lately. Do you know a good podcast?
dialogue.zh: 最近坐公交感觉很漫长。你知道什么好播客吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: What kind of topics do you like listening to?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I enjoy stories about everyday life, especially short ones.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢日常生活故事，尤其是简短的。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: There's a show about people and their unusual jobs.
dialogue.zh: 有一档节目讲人们和他们不寻常的工作。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: That sounds interesting. How long do the episodes usually last?
dialogue.zh: 听起来很有意思。每集通常有多长？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Most are around twenty minutes, about the length of your ride.
dialogue.zh: 大多数大约二十分钟，和你的车程差不多。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Do the guests speak quickly? I sometimes miss details.
dialogue.zh: 嘉宾说话快吗？我有时会漏掉细节。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Some do, but you can slow the playback in the app.
dialogue.zh: 有些人说得快，不过你可以在应用里调慢播放速度。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: That's helpful. Is there a transcript I can read later?
dialogue.zh: 这很有帮助。有没有文字稿可以之后看？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: The episode page has one for the interview I heard.
dialogue.zh: 我听过的那期采访在节目页面上有文字稿。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I'll try that episode on my way home today.
dialogue.zh: 我今天回家路上试着听听那一集。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Let me know what you think. We can compare favorite stories.
dialogue.zh: 告诉我你的感受。我们可以聊聊各自最喜欢的故事。

expressions.example: What kind of music do you enjoy?

expressions.zh: 大约二十分钟；around 表示约数。
expressions.example: The walk takes around twenty minutes.
I missed some details in the story.
You can slow the playback in this app.
Let me know when you get home.

pronunciation: podcast 重读第一个音节；episode 重读第一个音节，结尾为 /soʊd/，最后发 /d/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Listening
practice.prompt: When do you usually listen to podcasts or other audio?
practice.answer: I usually listen on the bus. A short story makes the ride feel more enjoyable.

practice.title: Part 2 · Something interesting you listened to
practice.prompt: Describe something interesting you listened to. Say what it was, when you heard it, and why you liked it.
practice.answer: I listened to a podcast interview during my ride home last week. A woman talked about her job repairing old musical instruments. The episode was about twenty minutes long, so I finished it before I reached my stop. I liked hearing how she learned the work from her grandfather. Later I read the transcript to understand a few details I had missed. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Audio and learning
practice.prompt: Why might audio programs be useful for learning?
practice.answer: People can listen while traveling or doing simple tasks. They can also replay difficult parts, although a transcript may help when the sound or topic is unfamiliar.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后描述你想听的播客，并询问时长和文字稿。
practice.answer: I'd like a podcast about everyday life. How long are the episodes? Is there a transcript I can read?
